claims.text: Portrait Roma is set above Via Condotti, steps from Piazza di Spagna and Trinità dei Monti, overlooking the rooftops of the city.

findings.quote: Set above Via Condotti, just steps from Piazza di Spagna and Trinità dei Monti, Portrait Roma is a beautiful Roman residence overlooking the rooftops of the city.

claims.text: The hotel is a short walk from the Spanish Steps and around the corner from the Six Senses and Hotel de Russie.

findings.quote: A skip away from the Spanish Steps, around the corner from the Six Senses and Hotel de Russie

claims.text: The hotel is owned by the Ferragamo family's Lungarno Collection, which has hotels in Florence and Milan.

findings.quote: The hotel is owned by Ferragamo family's Lungarno Collection with outposts in Florence and Milan.

claims.text: Portrait Roma is a member of The Leading Hotels of the World.

findings.quote: Portrait Roma is proud member of The Leading Hotels of the World.

claims.text: The suites combine living areas, private terraces and discreet kitchenettes, in the style of an elegant Roman home.

findings.quote: Living areas, private terraces and discreet kitchenette create the atmosphere of an elegant Roman home

claims.text: The Via Condotti Suite is designed like a one-bedroom apartment.

findings.quote: Via Condotti Suite, designed like a one-bedroom apartment

claims.text: In the Via Condotti Suite, wooden doors in the foyer hide a kitchenette with a cooking range.

findings.quote: In the foyer, a giant set of wooden doors reveals a surprise: not just hidden snack drawers and a fridge, but an entire kitchenette complete with a cooking range.

claims.text: Breakfast centres on Italian specialties and carefully selected ingredients.

findings.quote: Breakfast centres around Italian specialties and carefully selected ingredients

claims.text: There is no full-service restaurant; breakfast is served on the rooftop, indoors or out on the terrace.

findings.quote: There isn’t a full-service restaurant here, so breakfast is the main meal, served on the rooftop, either indoors or out on the terrace.

claims.text: Throughout the day the terrace is a setting for coffee, aperitivi or a glass of wine above Rome.

findings.quote: throughout the day the terrace becomes a natural setting for coffee, aperitivi or a glass of wine above Rome.

claims.text: Guests can go shopping with a personal stylist or take a food-shopping trip to Campo de' Fiori followed by a cooking class.

findings.quote: Go shopping with a personal stylist, or opt for a food-shopping trip to Campo de’ Fiori followed by a cooking class.

claims.text: Portrait Roma is pet friendly.

findings.quote: Portrait Roma is pet friendly.

claims.text: Ferragamo memorabilia, including vintage shoe molds, hand-drawn designs and photographs of celebrity muses, line the corridors and staircases.

findings.quote: A friend who, as it happens, is a member of the Ferragamo family. The family insignia is everywhere
vintage shoe molds, hand-drawn designs, and photographs of celebrity muses line the corridors and staircases

claims.text: The hotel was designed by Michele Bönan and inspired by the world of Salvatore Ferragamo.

findings.quote: Designed by Michele Bönan and inspired by the world of Salvatore Ferragamo

claims.text: The Trinità dei Monti Penthouse Suite comes with a private terrace, a tiny gym and a sauna.

findings.quote: Trinità dei Monti Penthouse Suite, which comes with a private terrace, tiny gym, and sauna.

claims.text: Portrait Roma has a rooftop terrace with panoramic views.

findings.quote: A rooftop terrace with panoramic views completes the atmosphere of discreet elegance

claims.text: The concierge can procure a meal from a guest's favorite restaurant and serve it on the terrace.

findings.quote: the concierge is more than happy to procure a meal from your favorite restaurant and serve it to you on the terrace.

claims.text: Because it is a small, historic townhouse, fully accessible room inventory is extremely limited; check with staff when booking.

findings.quote: Because it is a small, historic townhouse, fully accessible or ADA-compliant room inventory is extremely limited—check with staff when booking.
